arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/fz && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src=open('/app/submission/main.py').read().replace("\nmain()\n","")
g={}; exec(compile(src,"m","exec"),g)
req=json.load(open('/app/tmp/fz/c2.json'))
states, edges, fair, names, start, n = g['parse_graph']([[],[],[]],3,1,0,dict(req))
done=g['done_flags'](states,3,1)
adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
for eid,(s,lab,t) in enumerate(edges): adj[s].append((eid,t))
order=[start]; vis={start}; qi=0
while qi<len(order):
    u=order[qi]; qi+=1
    for eid,t in adj[u]:
        if t not in vis: vis.add(t); order.append(t)
reach=[False]*n
for u in order: reach[u]=True
print("reach",reach,"done",done)
DECL=(1<<len(fair))-1
lbit={a:1<<i for i,(a,m) in enumerate(fair)}
liveb=[reach[s] and not done[s] for s in range(n)]
live=[s for s in range(n) if liveb[s]]
enm=[0]*n
for s,lab,t in edges:
    b=lbit.get(lab)
    if b: enm[s]|=b
idmap={s:i for i,s in enumerate(live)}
print("live",live,"idmap",idmap,"enm",enm)
k=len(live); L=[[] for _ in range(k)]; mn=[]
for eid in range(len(edges)):
    s,lab,t=edges[eid]
    if s in idmap and t in idmap:
        b=lbit.get(lab)
        if b is None: L[idmap[s]].append(idmap[t])
        else:
            mid=len(L); L.append([]); mn.append((eid,b)); L[idmap[s]].append(mid); L[mid].append(idmap[t])
for i in range(k): L[i].append(i)
print("LG adj",L,"k",k,"mn",mn)
comps=g['tarjan_subset'](list(range(len(L))), set(range(len(L))), L)
print("comps",comps)
ens=[0]*len(L); ys=[0]*len(L); ms=[0]*len(L)
for i in range(k):
    e2=enm[live[i]]; ens[i]=e2; ys[i]=(~e2)&DECL
for j,(eid,b) in enumerate(mn):
    ys[k+j]=b; ms[k+j]=b
print("ens",ens,"ys",ys,"ms",ms)
mem=comps[0]
orE=0; orM=0; orY=0
for v in mem: orE|=ens[v]; orM|=ms[v]; orY|=ys[v]
print("orE",orE,"orM",orM,"orY",orY,"fair modes",fair)
EOF
